name: productive-crew
description: A design-system crew — Figma to tokens to component to tested, deployed Storybook. Agents write evidence; a script verifies it; the board derives status. Nobody types a status.

airtable_token.title: Airtable personal access token
airtable_token.description: Read/write on the base that holds your component registry. Create one at airtable.com/create/tokens with data.records:read, data.records:write and schema.bases:read. Leave blank if you would rather store it yourself with scripts/credentials.js.

asana_token.title: Asana personal access token
asana_token.description: Used to open and sync the component tickets. Leave blank to run the crew without ticketing.
